title: Шахраї
body:
Це не справжній застосунок, саме тому замість безкоштовного пробного періоду вам запропонують купити три дні за 1$, але так шахраї просто дізнаються дані вашої картки.

Застосунок не буде відображатися у ваших підписках на айфоні, тому ви не зможете його видалити і за три дні у вас з карти спишуть тридцятку або більше. 
«Підтримка» буде вас ігнорувати, присилаючи мейли, що ваш запис «обробляється», але вони просто тягнуть час. 
Якщо у вас вже списали кошти - якнайшвидше зверніться до вашого банку❤️

title: Мошенники / Scam
body:
По рекламе стало интересно - прошёл их тест и заказал себе книжку за 29.99$

Даже не устанавливая приложение

С меня сняли 2 раза по 29.99 типа за какую-то вторую книжку 

И спустя 2 недели с меня сняли 50$ за подписку - хотя я даже не включал приложение!

Зашёл в свои подписки на iphone что б проверить что это такое вообще - так у меня его даже в подписках нету!

Не советую покупать у них хоть что-то

--------------------
Based on the advertisement, I became interested - I passed their test and ordered a book for myself for $29.99

Without even installing the application

I was charged 2 times for 29.99 for some second book

And after 2 weeks they charged me $50 for the subscription - although I didn’t even turn on the application!

I went into my iPhone subscriptions to check what it was all about - I don’t even have it in my subscriptions!

I don't recommend buying anything from them

author: nkonant21

title: They took my money.
body:
I downloaded the app after I saw the advertisement. After that I payed for a demo subscription, and after that they tried to charge the whole amount. The card was rejected at first. I saw it and deleted the app which surprisingly did not cancel the subscription. And the money was taken after a day or two.
But here is the thing: since the app was not there I could not find this purchase/transaction in my ICloud to Restore a Purchase. And when I downloaded the app for the second time and logged in - there was no paid plan on my profile, and they wanted me to pay again! 

I issued it to my bank and contacted support on 22nd of December, and got the response on the 8th of January. And the response was: sorry there is nothing we can do about it.

title: Feedback
body:
Installed the offer for 3 days for a trial for $1 - 07/06/2022
After that, I didn’t find the button in the application to unsubscribe, I hit it and forgot about it. I did not like. As a result, $15 a week is withdrawn every week, $60 was accumulated in a month
I contacted the company - but they did not do anything, they continue to withdraw money.
You have to block the card.
I do not recommend. I think the application does not honestly deceive its users and withdraws money when not using the application.
Algis, Ukrainian

title: Annoying course pop-ups
body: I really love this app, it helps me stay on track and I use it everyday. It’s aesthetically pleasing and easy to use. However, there is something that really annoys me about this app. Everytime I set a goal it is mandatory to set and intention and motivation and all that stuff I just wish it was voluntary because I cannot waste my time doing something I’ve done multiple times before it just really angers me. So please make it voluntary I do enjoy the app and I think it’s great. It’s just this little thing that prevents this from being a positive experience. Thank you so much, developers.
